title: JAMS model component libraries
description:
Model component libraries for the JAMS framework (J2000 model family and related models). The libraries are used with the JAMS framework and its model editor JUICE.

Authors of the model component libraries

  • J2K_base: Peter Krause, Sven Kralisch, Christian Fischer, Andrew Watson, Annika Künne, Santosh Nepal (contributors: Heiko Busch, Holm Kipka, Corina Manusch, Christin Michel, Manfred Fink)
  • J2K_ext: Peter Krause, Sven Kralisch, Manfred Fink, Christin Michel, Bjoern Pfennig, Daniel Varga, Christian Fischer, Santosh Nepal, Holm Kipka, Heiko Busch (contributors: Sophie Biskop)
  • J2K_iso: Andrew Watson, Christian Birkel, Sven Kralisch, Christian Fischer
  • J2K_highres: Peter Krause, Manfred Fink (contributors: Sven Kralisch)
  • J2K_Africa: Andrew Watson, Sven Kralisch, Peter Krause
  • J2K_Himalaya: Santosh Nepal, Peter Krause, Manfred Fink (contributors: Sven Kralisch)
  • J2K_Irstea: Sven Kralisch, Peter Krause, François Tilmant, Mériem Labbas, Christian Fischer, Jordi Bolibar, Flora Branger, Isabelle Gouttevin, Jérémie Bonneau, Louise Mimeau, Santosh Nepal, Marko Adamovic, Thomas Cipriani (contributors: Michael Rabotin, Louise Crochemore, Nico Hachgenei)
  • J2K_Irstea_dev: Sven Kralisch, Nico Hachgenei, François Tilmant, Mériem Labbas, Christian Fischer, Nathan Pellerin, Louise Crochemore, Flora Branger, Peter Krause, Olivier Grandjouan, Anne-Lou Borgna, Jérémie Bonneau, Vincent Thiercelin, Manfred Fink, Olivier Champagne, Holm Kipka, Santosh Nepal, Isabelle Gouttevin, Jordi Bolibar
  • J2K_SASSCAL: Sven Kralisch, Markus Meinhardt, Peter Krause (contributors: Andrew Watson)
  • J2K_S_N: Manfred Fink, Peter Krause, Ulrike Bende-Michl, Hendrik Göhman, Holm Kipka, Sven Kralisch, Bjoern Pfennig, Christian Fischer (contributors: Marcel Wetzel, Frank Baese, François Tilmant)
  • J2Kg: Peter Krause, Sven Kralisch, Manfred Fink, Christian Fischer, Santosh Nepal
  • DRYvER: Sven Kralisch, Peter Krause
  • Thornthwaite: Sven Kralisch, Manfred Fink
